Dialogue_Text: You... you managed to win all the battles?! Well, it looks like you are not a normal adventurer, are you? Of course not, and I should have noticed that the moment you entered the Ink Gallery. You're <CHARNAME>, and that's the name of a very specific hero!
You are the Hero of Baldur's Gate, aren't you? The <PRO_MANWOMAN> who defeated Sarevok Anchev. And from what I have heard, you are also a Bhaalspawn.

Look, you don't need to worry and—that actually explains why one of the books reacted differently to you. The Moon Sisters—they recognized you somehow, and that shouldn't be possible. They are but a story now.

Perhaps you're the one that may help me with something. There is one more book, something I do not let others see, hidden in a secret room. There is a passage down into the basement, hidden under the fireplace. There is a special grate there. I found it when I moved in, and that hideout became my secret vault.
We should meet there. I want to show you something.
